However, I noticed recently that the OpenAI website was revamped, and the RSS link does not work anymore, and I am also unable to find the new link if it exists. Is the RSS feed gone forever or will it come back at some point? As an RSS enthusiast and someone who likes to be updated on OpenAI’s stuff, I would be very disappointed if it’s the former.
